parts.label: a
parts.technique: Syy calculation for regression/correlation
parts.reason: This calculation is preparatory work solely for computing the PMCC/regression line; S2.2 explicitly excludes calculations involving regression lines and S5.1 excludes calculation of correlation coefficients via formula, so this summary-statistic calculation for that purpose is out.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Calculate PMCC using formula
parts.reason: S5.1 explicit exclusion: 'calculation of correlation coefficients is excluded' and 'use of the formula is not required' - here students are given Sxx, Syy, Sxy and required to compute r by formula, which is explicitly excluded.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Interpret correlation coefficient
parts.reason: This part requires the value of r found in the excluded part (b); a part that only makes sense after an out-of-spec part is OUT.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Interpret correlation coefficient vs regression suitability
parts.reason: Depends on the excluded r value from (b); also relates to regression line suitability which is excluded under S2.2.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Find regression line equation
parts.reason: S2.2 explicit exclusion: 'calculations involving regression lines are excluded'.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Use regression line for prediction and reliability
parts.reason: Uses the regression line equation found in the excluded part (e); depends on an out-of-spec answer.
